name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq:
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 3 qubits with 3 layers of random rotations U, apply U^dagger, and verify the system returns to |0...0> with probability 1; then perturb one angle by 0.35 and report the echo decay. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
